name: @eimg/primer
description: Inspect organizational sources as authorized evidence and cited answers
author: Ei Maung

scripts.dev:offline: PRIMER_DATA_DIR=.primer/offline PRIMER_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=deterministic PRIMER_CHAT_PROVIDER=deterministic node --import tsx src/cli.ts
scripts.baseline:offline: npm run dev:offline -- init && npm run dev:offline -- sources ingest && npm run dev:offline -- evaluate
scripts.baseline:live: npm run dev -- init && npm run dev -- sources ingest && npm run dev -- evaluate
scripts.baseline:answers:offline: npm run dev:offline -- init && npm run dev:offline -- sources ingest && npm run dev:offline -- evaluate answers
scripts.baseline:answers:live: npm run dev -- init && npm run dev -- sources ingest && npm run dev -- evaluate answers
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm audit
